name: Tunlan
desc: Tunlan under her wide flat lampshade hat, a lamp hanging before her carved mask and long jointed fingers ready for the shadow gestures.

name: Noon Fair Puppets
desc: A painted paper lampshade hat in rose-lilac and chalk, dressed for the Shadowless Noon fair. Two rigid puppet rods hang at her belt.

name: Lamplit Shadows
desc: A walnut shade-hat with lampresin panels. Her shadows fall in muted violet.
